description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Adds or edits a STAR+Reflection story in the user's interview story bank, with where its claims come from. Write it from the CV and what the user told you; never invent figures, and mark anything you inferred as unverified. Only the fields you pass change. At most 50 stories.

action.description: STAR: what the user did. Omit to keep; an empty string clears it.

archived.description: true hides the story from list_stories; false shows it again.

provenance.description: Where the claims come from. cv: the user's CV; user_stated: the user told you in this conversation; unverified: you drafted or inferred it; user_cannot_confirm: the user does not know. Required for a new story. cv and user_stated need source_note; cv numbers must appear in the user's CV.

reflection.description: What the user learned or would do differently. Omit to keep; an empty string clears it.

result.description: STAR: the outcome, with the user's own figures. Omit to keep; an empty string clears it.

situation.description: STAR: the context. Omit to keep; an empty string clears it.

skills.description: Skills or question themes it answers; replaces the list.

source_note.description: Where in the CV, or what the user said. Omit to keep; an empty string clears it.

story_id.description: Story id from list_stories, to edit it. Omit to add one.

task.description: STAR: what the user had to do. Omit to keep; an empty string clears it.

title.description: Short name; saving the same title again updates that story.

name: save_story
title: Save an interview story
